cover_headline: Yields bite, and CPI day decides the ASX
cover_subhead: The US 10-year hit 5.28% overnight, its highest since 2007, and today's August CPI print decides whether local stocks shrug it off.
cover_pullquote: Our read: a cautious open, then the 11:30am CPI print sets the tone for the day.
big_story_headline: US yields at an 18-year high put rate-sensitive ASX names on notice
big_story_intro: Wall Street slipped as the US 10-year yield touched 5.28% after soft confidence data failed to calm rate fears. Futures point to a softer ASX open, with tech and property most exposed, and August CPI at 11:30am is the day's big swing factor.
big_story_outro: A hot CPI firms a November hike; a soft one gives tech some breathing room.
pineapple_take_quote: Expect a cautious, yield-watching morning that turns on the CPI print.
pineapple_take_body: The RBA has already said it's prepared to keep lifting, and Westpac sees headline inflation near 4%. If the print lands hot, rate-sensitive tech and REITs wear it; if it's soft, today's dip looks like a buying window for the patient.
